description: This file contains unit tests for the SearchSourceBuilder class within the org.eclipse.ditto.services.utils.search package. It verifies the correct construction of search sources, validation of options, and error handling for invalid inputs.

classes.name: SearchSourceBuilderTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing SearchSourceBuilder functionalities and error handling.

methods.description: Shuts down the ActorSystem after tests are executed.

methods.description: Tests failure when DittoHeaders are missing.
